observations: The user reported that VR presentation was available from game startup, Create recenter behaved correctly and the SteamVR interface did not remain stuck over the game in this run.

The flat-menu Sense ray and visible cursor worked, but none of the Sense buttons activated the menu. Telemetry recorded 15 Win32 left-button down/up pairs, physically rejecting Win32 mouse injection as the CoJ menu-select route.

The game survived loading and reached gameplay. The user observed that the post-load simulation remained frozen until keyboard or mouse input, matching the shipped GameUILoading.WaitForUserInput timer gate.
Local first-person head/hair suppression worked visually and the user reported that the head no longer obstructed the HMD view.

Both arm writers remained stable and restored cleanly, but the arms were still visibly twisted and felt short. Clamp asymmetry and very large hand-orientation residuals support keeping Body IK visually unpromoted.

Sense gameplay actions reached the existing input bridge, but locomotion and running felt coarse. The old bridge converted stick movement through desktop digital directional actions, so smooth analog locomotion requires a separate host-tested correction.
Shots still originated from the native player/fire-origin boundary. Controller tip direction does not by itself move the ballistic origin.
